what_they_do: Fireproof is a records management and PPE/asset compliance platform built specifically for fire departments. It replaces manual, paper-and-spreadsheet record keeping for incident documentation, training logs, hydrant data, inspections, and investigations, and layers in AI agents for voice-to-text incident narratives, after-action review facilitation, dispatch audio transcription, and anomaly detection. A second core module tracks the full lifecycle of personal protective equipment (cleaning, repairs, inspections, work orders) to keep departments compliant with NFPA 1850.
vertical: vertical SaaS / public safety records management
theme_fit_rationale: Fireproof embeds AI (voice-to-text, transcription of dispatch audio, anomaly detection) into a domain-specific workflow (fire department incident and PPE records) where switching costs are high once a department standardizes its RMS, matching Theme 1's focus on VLM/AI-embedded vertical software with labor displacement and error reduction, in an industry (public safety) explicitly named as a use case. Secondary fit with Theme 5: the product's wedge is ingesting unstructured inputs (voice narratives, dispatch audio) that legacy fire RMS tools can't read, then using that as the entry point into automating downstream compliance and reporting workflows (NERIS, accreditation, PPE lifecycle).
workflow_artifacts: PPE/turnout gear inventory and inspection records

recent_signals.summary: NFPA 1850 (the consolidated PPE standard merging former NFPA 1851/1852) reaches its enforcement date, creating a hard compliance deadline for fire departments' turnout gear and SCBA lifecycle management, directly relevant to Fireproof's PPE compliance module.
